title: Classify index not-ready retries from the actual availability condition
outcome: Classify index not-ready retries from the actual availability condition
acceptance: A follower observing a writer rebuild emits retryRecommended:true with a progress retryHint and self-recovers when the writer becomes ready.
A non-queryable writer publication boundary with state ready is retryable, while a genuinely terminal writer failure remains non-retryable.
Tests bind the retry classifier to every IndexManager state and exercise reachable not-ready envelopes.

completion.summary: Index not-ready retryability now uses actual access mode and availability conditions; real follower rebuild/recovery coverage verifies transient retry guidance.
